title: 扩散语言模型实验分析
summary: 本文系统分析了八种现代扩散语言模型在八个基准上的表现，涵盖推理、编码、翻译等任务，并探讨了推理阶段关键因素（如去噪步数、上下文长度）对性能与效率的影响，揭示了扩散模型在不同任务和架构下的权衡。
summary_en: This paper presents a systematic experimental analysis of eight state-of-the-art diffusion language models across eight benchmarks, covering reasoning, coding, translation, etc., and examines the impact of key inference-time factors on performance and efficiency, revealing trade-offs across tasks and architectures.
